anchor.snippet: await page.keyboard.type('/mcp verbose', { delay: 80 }); await page.keyboard.press('Enter');

entries.note: The installed CLI emits a banner before startup is idle. Wait for its OSC title to return from busy to the project name, then use ordinary key pacing. Zero-delay automated typing left the slash command unsubmitted; 80 ms key intervals passed, and recorded PTY input confirms Enter was delivered as carriage return. This test sends a CLI status command only, never a coding prompt.
